items.d: It opens with demo data, so you can look around before you connect anything.
Your LevelPlay Secret Key and Refresh Token are stored in the iPhone Keychain.
There is no backend. The app talks to LevelPlay directly from your device.
Exchange rates come from frankfurter.dev. The ad SDKs in the free version follow their own policies, and you are asked for consent.
